title: CPU cold-expert tier, CUDA streaming, and poller lifetime

sources.notes: Python validation, ctypes ownership, borrowed arena views, fail-soft committed-prefix CUDA registration, poller raw-pointer lifetime, counters, and process singletons are modeled. Tensor payloads and ctypes mechanics are abstract. close has no matching cudaHostUnregister and does not coordinate the singleton poller.

Models expert-major route grouping, one packed transfer per active expert, copy/compute event ring ordering, borrowed host-block lifetime, exact empty-route zero, weighted scatter, and singleton reuse. Numerical CUDA kernels are abstract. stats slot_bytes disagrees with the packed allocation formula; bytes_streamed uses the correct _block_bytes.

Obsolete standalone kernel-spinning signal helper. It has no phase4 caller/build rule, accepts no explicit stream, prints launch errors without returning status, and is modeled only as an inactive alternative to Driver stream-memory operations.

Intended median latency/thread-scaling and implied-bandwidth harness. It has source-visible API drift: bench passes bf16 tensors to the live PackedPlane-only load_expert and calculates bf16 rather than packed traffic, so it is inventory and intended comparison, not current execution evidence.

Primary native semantics: hugepage-advised bump arena, dense residency table, checkpoint-native packed decode, persistent generation/barrier worker pool, fp32 SwiGLU, route histogram/prefix/gather/scatter, skipped-route counter, borrowed block, signal sweep, backoff, unconditional completion, telemetry, and destructor ownership. SIMD and floating-point payloads are abstract.
Authoritative C ABI, packed layout, error convention, routing partial, borrow duration, arena statistics, host-mapped flag protocol, caller-owned pointer lifetime, and destruction-order contract.

CPU functional comparison intent for arena residency, direct and routed FFN, shared-expert gather/scatter, exact all-skip zero, counted nonresidency, Python guards, and reload-without-growth. No result from this harness is claimed here.

Packed-format differential intent against vLLM dequantize_to_dtype, including density, nibble/sign/scale behavior, gscale order, routed sums, and malformed plane rejection. No result from this harness is claimed here.

Native poller contract fixture: caller-kept buffers, signal value as M, untouched rows beyond M, direct-compute comparison, telemetry, and failed-dispatch completion release. No result from this harness is claimed here.

CUDA-required comparison intent for contiguous packed sections, registration, streamed-versus-host routed partials, ring reuse, -1 routes, exact empty zero, per-layer isolation, and counters. No result from this harness is claimed here.

Relevant active dependency, not part of the assigned ownership inventory: CUDA Driver stream-memory operations provide the production graph-compatible flag mechanism that distinguishes sb_stream.cu as obsolete.

Relevant caller boundary, not owned here: stages CPU buffers, enqueues signal/wait operations, selects host versus CUDA streaming by batch policy, and aggregates the CPU partial. Detailed integration is assigned elsewhere.

assumptions: The model bounds expert identities to {0,1}, routed entries and signal batch values to 0..2, and layer validity to layer 0 versus bounded invalid layer 1; these are finite identity abstractions, not production geometry.

Tensor contents, packed floating-point decode, exact reduction order, PCIe timing, THP realization, CUDA memory ordering, and kernel execution are abstracted to route counts, zero/nonzero observation, validity, and event order.

Direct host computation is split into bucket, gather, FFN, and scatter actions; CpuPoller::loop calls moe_forward atomically and is represented by one guarded pollDispatch action whose result derives from the registered layer identity.
The caller serializes the shared host scratch and owns placement correctness; the native host implementation is not assumed reentrant.
Negative and out-of-range IDs are absent routes, while an in-range nonresident ID is counted as a skipped correctness fault and omitted without changing moe_forward's success return.
Mapped flags and pinned arrays remain alive through poller destruction, and borrowed expert-block views remain valid only until host destruction.
CUDA arena registration failure is fail-soft for throughput, but absence of a matching unregister in CpuExpertHost.close remains an implementation lifecycle gap.
The active graph signaling dependency is stream_signal.py; sb_stream.cu is intentionally modeled as inactive because no phase4 call/build path references it.
Harness source is comparison intent only. No build, test, benchmark, lint, formatter, hardware workload, or Reyu gate was run by this agent.

implementation_checks.description: Compare native packed FFN and routed output with vLLM dequantize_to_dtype over identical random bytes; cover nibble order, E4M3FN, global-scale multiplication, packed density, and malformed shapes.
Compare resident direct and bucketed routed results with explicit PyTorch weighted sums; inspect exact empty zeros, repeated expert rows, monotonic skipped nonresident count, and reload arena usage.
Compare direct moe_forward with signal-driven dispatch for bounded M, verify rows beyond M remain untouched, and inspect completion plus error_count for an invalid layer.

On CUDA-capable hardware, compare streamed and CPU partials across more experts than ring slots, empty and -1 routes, and same expert ID in different layers; use bounded tolerance rather than bit equality.
Source-inspect that first load allocates one contiguous six-section block while reload resolves the existing slot and cannot increase arena used bytes.
Source-inspect signal clearing before dispatch, sequential fences, unconditional completion after both return branches, error telemetry, and spin-then-20us-sleep backoff.
Source-inspect lifetime ownership: borrowed tensors and native poller pointers are not reference-counted against host destruction, and pinned arena teardown has no cudaHostUnregister call.
Compare reported slot_bytes with _ring allocation and _block_bytes; document the current packed-size telemetry discrepancy rather than treating the report as allocation truth.

Source-inspect benchmark drift before execution: verify whether it constructs PackedPlane inputs and reports packed traffic; the checked-in version instead passes bf16 tensors and computes bf16 bytes.
Search phase4 call/build references and compare the helper's implicit stream, print-only error handling, and unbounded spin with the active stream_signal.py Driver operations.
